title: Baseball Poker
wildNotice: 3s and 9s are wild. A face-up 4 pays a card, a face-up 3 buys the pot
label.buyIn: A face-up 3. Pay {{amount}} to stay in?
tutorial.hand: 3s and 9s are always wild. With eight of them in the deck, the going rate for a hand rises
tutorial.seats: Every seat's face-up cards are visible. A seat showing 3s or 9s is stronger than it looks
tutorial.buy: A face-up 3 forces a choice: pay the pot as it stands and carry on, or drop out
frontendHint.baseballHandIsWorthTheBuy: two pair or better is worth the price
frontendHint.baseballBuyIsCheapEnough: it is cheap against your stack
frontendHint.baseballBuyCostsTooMuch: it is too heavy against your stack
frontendHint.baseballStrongEnoughToBet: trips or better is worth a bet
frontendHint.baseballStrongEnoughToRaise: a flush or better can push here
frontendHint.baseballWorthACall: two pair or better is worth this price
frontendHint.baseballCheapToStay: it is cheap enough to see one more card
frontendHint.baseballWildsRaiseTheBar: with eight wilds in the deck this hand does not meet the going rate
